identity.source: human-authored PRODUCT_REFERENCE.md from the original product-photo session
facts: Short-sleeve loose babydoll blouse in solid pale periwinkle / dusty light blue.
Oversized double-layer rounded Peter Pan collar with ruffle trim around the yoke seam.
Three flower-shaped buttons and vertical pintuck pleats at the center front.
Short puffed sleeves with elastic-gathered ruffle cuffs.
Lightweight matte cotton/poplin with soft drape; no print, embroidery, or fabric-face logo.
mustPreserve: double-layer rounded collar and yoke ruffle
three flower-shaped front buttons and pintuck pleats
mustNotInvent: a fabric print, embroidery, or logo
additional buttons or a fitted/tailored cut
an interior brand label in a public hero scene

sceneIntent.fallback: Create premium product-commercial scenes such as a styled rack, ghost-mannequin, or editorial close-up. These are new scenes, not copies of the raw catalog background.
rejectionCriteria: wrong garment color, collar, button count, sleeve/cuff, or silhouette
unbelievable human anatomy, hands, fit, or garment attachment
raw catalog props/background retained as the claimed generated scene
